answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 32221 Country: India Title: Girl's right of nikah etc Question: 1.Is engagement authentic according to islam? 2.Is islam allow a girl to choose a boy for her marriage or not? 3. A syed can marry with khan girl. " Answer ID: 32221 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 792/662/B=1432) (1) The prevalent mangani (engagement) in which involves gifts and feasts is not proved by the Shariah. (2) If that girl is mature she can choose any boy herself, but it is better to seek the advice of one's parents and elder members of the family. Such marriages carry blessings. (3) Yes, a Sayyid boy can marry a Khan girl. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
